description: This file defines the VoiceWakePreferences enum, which manages voice wake trigger words, including loading, saving, sanitizing, and decoding them from JSON data. It also provides default trigger words and limits on the number and length of trigger words.

methods.name: decodeGatewayTriggers(from:)
methods.description: Decodes a JSON string containing trigger words into an array of strings, sanitizing the result.

methods.name: decodeGatewayTriggers(from: Data)
methods.description: Decodes JSON data into an array of trigger words.

methods.name: loadTriggerWords
methods.description: Loads trigger words from user defaults or returns default trigger words.

methods.name: saveTriggerWords
methods.description: Saves custom trigger words to user defaults.

methods.name: sanitizeTriggerWords
methods.description: Sanitizes the list of trigger words by trimming whitespace, filtering out empty entries, and limiting count and length.

methods.name: displayString
methods.description: Returns a comma-separated string of sanitized trigger words.
